policy: Post-hoc nested sensitivity model adds fixed x/y gradients of original scene model as unconstrained nuisance templates. Original control amplitudes retained. All recorded events in two previously discordant sectors. Shift each event center by 0.1–0.9 periods; mask all true-event windows from control events and baselines. Fixed archived templates, no registration refit. Inject target PRF at observed conditional target-fit amplitude. Windows overlap; no false-alarm probabilities or model-mismatch calibration. No selection by control outcome.
